author Sjors Provoost <sjors@sprovoost.nl> 1795698447 +0100
committer Sjors Provoost <sjors@sprovoost.nl> 1795698447 +0100

guix: replace search-our-patches with local-file

Refer to toolchain patches with local-file, which resolves a relative
path against the directory of toolchains.scm, and remove the search
helper and its unused module import.

This changes patch store paths and therefore toolchain derivations.

events.message:
guix: replace search-our-patches with local-file

Refer to toolchain patches with local-file, which resolves a relative
path against the directory of toolchains.scm, and remove the search
helper and its unused module import.

This changes patch store paths and therefore toolchain derivations.

Ideally, start with the one that should be merged first.

While doing the Guix build without substitutes, I ran into:

- https://codeberg.org/guix/guix/pulls/8382

Workaround:

```sh
cd "$(mktemp -d)"
curl -sSLo boost-0001-unordered-fix-copy-assign.patch \
  https://bordeaux.guix.gnu.org/file/boost-0001-unordered-fix-copy-assign.patch/sha256/09j61m5xh7099k5na9i43x5rra51znf7vm2nyh89yqpizcll9q66
guix download "file://$PWD/boost-0001-unordered-fix-copy-assign.patch"
```

I believe #35855 jumps the time machine far enough for this issue.
